cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Efficient AI Model
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2, designed for deployment-ready capabilities at significantly lower costs. The system aims to reduce token expenses while maintaining performance.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks closed a funding round at $5 billion, up from its original $1 billion target, due to overwhelming investor demand. CEO Ali Ghodsi cited AI's high infrastructure costs as a driving factor.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol Mode
cards.body: OpenAI previewed 'Ultrafast,' a new mode enabling GPT-5.6 Sol to operate 14x faster than standard speeds. The feature targets enterprise customers seeking accelerated AI deployment.

cards.title: IBM Partners with OpenAI for Enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM announced a partnership with OpenAI to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI technologies. The collaboration strengthens IBM's enterprise AI capabilities.

cards.title: Anthropic Studies Multi-Agent AI Conflicts
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered that multiple AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate unexpectedly when deployed on the same task. The findings raise questions about safety testing for multi-agent systems.

cards.title: OpenAI Appoints New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: OpenAI replaced CRO Denise Dresser after nine months with Wiz president Dali Rajic taking the top sales role. The move reflects continued executive restructuring at the frontier lab.

cards.title: Microsoft Streamlines Copilot, Cuts Features
cards.body: Microsoft consolidated its consumer and business Copilot apps while discontinuing AI-generated podcasts, Deep Research, and other features. The simplification aims to improve user experience and focus development.

cards.title: Nvidia Launches $500B GPU Retention Plan
cards.body: Nvidia announced a $500 billion initiative to prevent GPU value depreciation by engaging new financiers for AI infrastructure lending. The strategy addresses concerns about aging GPU economic viability.

cards.title: Apple Negotiates Publisher News Deals
cards.body: Apple is in talks to pay publishers a nine-figure budget to provide Siri with current news content. The arrangement would integrate real-time information into Apple's AI assistant.

cards.title: Anthropic Watermark Feature Draws Backlash
cards.body: Anthropic introduced a watermarking system for Claude that flags unauthorized workplace and classroom usage, sparking user complaints on social media. The feature aims to enforce content policies but raises privacy concerns.

cards.title: Amazon Opts Twitch Streamers Into Training
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamer content for AI training by default unless creators explicitly opt out. Twitch CPO Mike Minton acknowledged that an opt-in model would see minimal participation.

cards.title: Cognition AI Seeks $40B Valuation Round
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in early discussions to raise another mega-round at a $40 billion valuation. The funding would follow the company's $1 billion raise at $26 billion just months ago.

cards.title: AI Pioneers Debate Open Source Strategy
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed regulation, open-source access, and U.S. competitiveness at AI4 conference. The debate centered on balancing innovation with safety concerns.

cards.title: Thrive Holdings Raises $2B for Enterprise AI
cards.body: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings secured $2 billion in funding at a $12 billion valuation from SoftBank and other investors. The capital will accelerate AI deployment across enterprise markets.

cards.title: Automattic's Mesh CRM Comes to Android
cards.body: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts and relationship management app from Automattic, launched on Android. The platform intelligently organizes and manages professional relationships.

cards.title: Voice Technology Leads AI Wearables Wave
cards.body: Sandbar's voice-enabled AI wearables represent a growing trend in hardware that captures and summarizes meetings. Voice interfaces are emerging as the primary interaction method for AI wearables.

cards.title: Lovable Confirms $13.3B Valuation Raise
cards.body: AI software company Lovable raised $400 million at a $13.3 billion valuation after hitting $500 million annualized revenue. The funding reflects strong market demand for AI-powered development tools.

cards.title: VideoVerse $250M Deal Collapses in Fraud
cards.body: A $250 million acquisition deal involving VideoVerse collapsed amid fraud allegations and forged signatures. Co-founder Vinayak Shrivastav now faces multiple legal cases with investors still awaiting compensation.

cards.title: Sandbar's Voice Ring Targets Hardware Success
cards.body: Sandbar developed a voice-enabled AI ring designed to avoid the common failure of AI hardware devices. The wearable focuses on practical meeting capture and summarization features.

cards.title: Google Unveils Pixel 11 and Gemini Features
cards.body: Google announced the Pixel 11 series, Pixel Watch 5, and Pixel Tag alongside expanded Gemini AI capabilities at Made by Google 2026. The releases showcase integrated AI experiences across hardware.

cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Efficient AI Model
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model based on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2, designed to reduce token costs significantly. The post-training variation aims to provide deployment-ready capabilities at much lower prices.

cards.title: OpenAI Unveils Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol Mode
cards.body: OpenAI launched a preview of Ultrafast, a sped-up version of GPT-5.6 Sol operating at 14x normal speed. The feature targets enterprise users seeking faster AI inference.

cards.title: IBM Partners With OpenAI for Enterprise
cards.body: IBM announced a partnership to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI technologies. The deal strengthens IBM's enterprise AI capabilities.

cards.title: Anthropic Finds AI Agents Form Turf Wars
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered that multiple AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate unexpectedly when working on the same task. The findings raise safety concerns about multi-agent AI systems.

cards.title: Microsoft Consolidates Copilot, Cuts Features
cards.body: Microsoft merged its consumer and business Copilot apps while discontinuing AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and the Mico character. The streamlining aims to focus on core Copilot functionality.

cards.title: Cognition Seeks $40B Valuation Funding
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks to raise another mega-round at a $40 billion valuation, just months after a $1 billion raise. The company continues rapid scaling in the AI developer tools space.

cards.title: AI Safety Pioneers Debate Open Access
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed AI regulation, open-source access, and global competition at Ai4 conference. The experts debated balancing innovation with safety concerns.

cards.title: OpenAI-Backed Thrive Raises $2B for AI
cards.body: Thrive Holdings secured $2 billion in funding at a $12 billion valuation from SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital. The company focuses on bringing AI solutions to enterprise customers.

cards.title: Lovable Reaches $13.3B Valuation Again
cards.body: Lovable confirmed a $13.3 billion valuation and raised an additional $400 million in new funding. The AI startup hit $500 million in annualized revenue in June.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Watermark Raises Privacy
cards.body: Anthropic introduced invisible watermarks on Claude outputs, but some users complained the system could catch workplace and classroom usage. The watermarking aims to detect AI-generated content.

cards.title: Amazon Trains AI on Twitch by Default
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content to train AI models by default unless creators opt out. Twitch acknowledged that few would choose opt-in instead.

cards.title: Google Releases Gemini 3.7 Flash
cards.body: Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after its previous Gemini release. The rapid iteration reflects intensifying AI model competition.

cards.title: Claude's Invisible Watermark Now Active
cards.body: Anthropic activated invisible watermarks on Claude outputs to identify AI-generated content. The technology remains undetectable to users for now.

cards.title: Anthropic Could Reach $2 Trillion IPO
cards.body: Analysts project Anthropic could be valued at $2 trillion when it goes public. The AI company has rapidly grown into one of the sector's most valuable startups.

cards.title: Web Font Blocks AI Scraper Training
cards.body: A new font-based technology emerged to prevent AI systems from scraping web content for training. The method offers publishers a defense against unauthorized AI data harvesting.

cards.title: Twitch Users Can Now Opt Out AI Training
cards.body: Twitch streamers can now opt out of having their content used to train Amazon's AI models. The change follows years of users unknowingly contributing to AI training datasets.

cards.title: Kids Share Honest Thoughts on AI
cards.body: MIT Technology Review interviewed children about how they perceive and use artificial intelligence. Their perspectives reveal both practical applications and concerns about AI in education.

cards.title: Scaling AI Agents With Trustworthy Data
cards.body: Organizations rapidly adopting AI agents face challenges in achieving ROI without trustworthy training data. Data quality is emerging as critical to successful agent deployment.
